_doc: SEED-SHIP-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-21): "For any seed based on the ultrastable platform, the system actually has to build and deploy it and make it fully autonomous with a design goal of being completely unsupervised and unattended for a minimum of 1 year." A seed is any system started on the platform: a directory under instances/ (IDEA.md or instance.json) or a tenant row in instances/ultrastable/progress.json. A design proposal is not a seed that shipped. Each seed declares in instances/<id>/ship.json what is built (paths and tests), where it is deployed (Worker id, URL, health URL) and how it runs a year unattended (heartbeat, progress row, credentials watched for expiry, monthly budget, dependency updates, self-repair workflows). foundation/seedship.py computes each seed's stage from the repository (proposed, built, deployed, autonomous), never from a declared status, files one Q-SEED-<id> item for every seed short of autonomous (p0 once it is older than ship_within_days) and closes it when its probe passes. Consumers: foundation/seedship.py (--check in .github/workflows/checks.yml, --run --apply in .github/workflows/watchdog.yml), seed/bootstrap/bootstrap.py (stage unattended writes the same readiness for a booted system), doctrine/detectors.json detector seed-ship, tests/foundation/test_seedship.py.

target.statement: Every seed is built, deployed and runs unattended for at least one year (Rowan, 2026-11-21).

readiness.what: a health URL over https and a heartbeat at most max_heartbeat_hours apart, so a silent seed is noticed
a row in instances/ultrastable/progress.json with expect_hours at most max_progress_hours, so the cadence monitor dispatches repairs and files STALL items
every credential the seed uses is in doctrine/credwatch.json, probed for expiry before it lapses (an empty list is best)
a stated monthly budget, and the Worker declared in doctrine/topology.json so the cost probe and free-plan guard cover it
every package directory of the seed is in .github/dependabot.yml, so dependency drift is updated and merged by the sweeper
heal workflows that exist and are named on the progress row, so a stalled seed is restarted with no person
the seed inherits seed/autonomy/yearsim.json and the standing goal core.year.unattended in seed/autonomy/goals.json

exempt.ultrastable: tenant 0: the platform itself, judged by unattended, runway and yearsim directly
exempt.spinoffs: apps launched by the spinoff loop, each judged by foundation/spinoff.py and the progress-apps rule
exempt.qnfo: an existing fleet adopted onto the foundation in its own account and repositories; it was built and deployed before it became a seed

baseline._doc: Shrink-only: seeds that predate SEED-SHIP-1 and have no ship.json yet. Each still gets its Q-SEED item; an entry leaves when its ship.json lands. A new seed may not be added here.
